caption:
Feel too ordinary for God to use? He took a shepherd over the priest. (Amos 7:15 devotional)

A true calling doesn't come from office or pedigree — it comes from the One who takes hold of you. He calls and uses the ordinary you.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Do I disqualify myself as too plain for God to call?
